assumptions: fixed gas and original scoped atomic model per lane
strictly ordered positive active E with unchanged CUT, SPLIT, UPPER and source tag meanings
same E used for all grid-dependent construction, projection and number functionals
exact arithmetic for mathematical identities; actual FP64 residuals require their own evidence
ionization sharing weights nonnegative and sum exactly to one for the algebraic derivation
whole saved source vectors retained, including cutoff and counters

formulae.name: energy_functional
formulae.excluded: low_cross diagnostics and all number ledgers

formulae.name: ionization_corrected_number
formulae.meaning: injected free-electron number after accounting for new ionization electrons

formulae.name: cutoff
formulae.formula: W<=C: cutoff_number=p, cutoff_energy=p*W; C<W<E_1: lower barycentric count at C goes into separate cutoff ledgers; no heat transfer

formulae.name: drift_column
formulae.coefficient_units: s^-1 for active/energy rows; (eV s)^-1 for number rows

formulae.name: column_conservation
formulae.limitation: structural exact-arithmetic identity, not a measured production residual

formulae.name: ramp_ledger
formulae.formula: dy/du=G*y+u*b, y(0)=0 implies ell^T y(u)=u^2*ell^T b/2

formulae.name: two_active_toy
formulae.formula: E1=1 eV; E2=2 eV; d=1 s^-1; A_col2=(d/2,-d,d/2); E2_new=2 eV+epsilon; residual=d*epsilon/[(2 eV)*(2 eV+epsilon)]

formulae.name: one_ulp_toy
formulae.limitation: not a bound on actual G or a statement of scientific acceptability

formulae.name: coordinate_transformation
formulae.limitation: patching node labels alone does not perform this transformation; E also parametrizes physical rates

formulae.name: drift_sensitivity
assumptions: small perturbations relative to relevant scales
formulae.limitation: no certified operator or observable error bound follows without additional estimates

functionals: inverse node energies for number ledger

preserved_conditionally: original drift, atomic, source, cutoff and ledger definitions
not_proved_by_exact_E: scientific PASS or authorization for physical retry
counterexample_check: exact_toy_check.py; actual outcome recorded separately in TOY_CHECK_RECEIPT.json
